protocol: Exploratory, single-reviewer visible-person count spot checks made from prepared clips before model execution. Not a held-out dataset, no independent second review, no exhaustive box/identity/event ground truth. Count a person only when visually distinguishable; abstain when occlusion prevents a reliable count. Checkpoints are at exact clip seconds; nearest inference sample must be within 0.11 seconds.
